# RTI Press

> RTI Press publishes peer-reviewed research on public health, education, data science, and international development with focus on evidence-based interventions and inclusive data practices.

RTI Press is the publishing arm of RTI International, a research institute conducting studies across health equity, education outcomes, environmental justice, and digital innovation. The site features articles on emerging technologies like digital twins and IoT sensors, alongside foundational research in early childhood education, gender-inclusive data collection, and workforce development.

## Key Topics

- public health
- data collection
- international development
- early-grade reading
- digital twins
- IoT sensors
- gender-inclusive data
- environmental health
- primary education
- smart cities
- wearable technology
- disease forecasting
- sex disaggregation
- evidence-based interventions
- equity and inclusion

## Education & Student Success

- [Data for Students: The Potential of Data and Analytics for Student Success](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/17261-data-for-students-the-potential-of-data-and-analytics-for-student-success): Data analytics framework for postsecondary education & student outcomes
- [Early Mathematics Counts: Promising Instructional Strategies From Low- and Middle-Income Countries](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/9678-early-mathematics-counts-promising-instructional-strategies-from-low-and-middle-income-countries): Literature review of early grade math interventions in low-income countries
- [Resetting Targets: Examining Large Effect Sizes and Disappointing Benchmark Progress](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/8870-resetting-targets-examining-large-effect-sizes-and-disappointing-benchmark-progress): Evidence-based guidance on target setting for early grade reading programs
- [Parent Teacher Home Visits: An Approach to Addressing Biased Mindsets and Practices to Support Student Success](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/38550-parent-teacher-home-visits-an-approach-to-addressing-biased-mindsets-and-practices-to-support-student-success): PTHV program addressing implicit bias to improve student outcomes
- [Girls Have Academic Advantages and So Do Boys: A Multicountry Analysis of Gender Differences in Early Grade Reading and Mathematics Outcomes](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/74607-girls-have-academic-advantages-and-so-do-boys-a-multicountry-analysis-of-gender-differences-in-early-grade-reading-and-mathematics-outcomes): Multicountry analysis of gender differences in early primary learning

## Data Science & Measurement Methods

- [Cyclical Tree-Based Hot Deck Imputation](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/81569-cyclical-tree-based-hot-deck-imputation): CTBHD statistical method for multivariate missing data imputation
- [Standard Measurement Protocols for Pediatric Development Research in the PhenX Toolkit](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/38275-standard-measurement-protocols-for-pediatric-development-research-in-the-phenx-toolkit): NIH-supported PhenX Toolkit pediatric development measurement protocols
- [A Global Call to Action for Gender-Inclusive Data Collection and Use](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/30152-a-global-call-to-action-for-gender-inclusive-data-collection-and-use): Paradigm shift from binary to gender-disaggregated data collection

## Public Health & Clinical Research

- [Making Clinical Trials More Patient-Centered Using Digital Interactive E-Consent Tools](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/10774-making-clinical-trials-more-patient-centered-using-digital-interactive-e-consent-tools): E-consent digital tools for patient-centered clinical trial participation
- [How Effective Are Healthy Eating Interventions Delivered in Early Childhood Education and Care Settings? A Cochrane Review Summary With Commentary](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/121229-how-effective-are-healthy-eating-interventions-delivered-in-early-childhood-education-and-care-settings-a-cochrane-review-summary-with-commentary): Cochrane systematic review of healthy eating programs in early childhood
- [Harms to Women and Children From Men's Alcohol Use: An Evidence Review and Directions for Policy](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/144947-jumpstarting-north-carolina-s-blue-economy-opportunities-in-ecosystem-technologies): Evidence review & policy options for reducing harmful male alcohol use

## Digital Innovation & IoT Technologies

- [Using Digital Twins to Understand Environmental Health Impacts](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/146217-using-digital-twins-to-understand-environmental-health-impacts): Digital twins & IoT sensors for tracking disease spread in smart cities
- [Weed Light: An Exploratory Study of Delta-8 THC Conversations on Reddit](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/36713-weed-light-an-exploratory-study-of-delta-8-thc-conversations-on-reddit): Social media monitoring of Delta-8 THC for FDA regulatory compliance

## Workforce, Equity & Research Careers

- [The Emerging Equity Scholars Program: A Belonging Intervention to Address Othering in Research Careers](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/125415-the-emerging-equity-scholars-program-a-belonging-intervention-to-address-othering-in-research-careers): RTI's Emerging Equity Scholars Program supporting historically excluded researchers
- [Addressing Police Turnover: Challenges, Strategies, and Future Research Directions](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/132453-addressing-police-turnover-challenges-strategies-and-future-research-directions): Narrative review of officer retention strategies & workforce management

## Environmental Justice & Economic Development

- [Environmental Justice Concerns and the Proposed Atlantic Coast Pipeline Route in North Carolina](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/9609-environmental-justice-concerns-and-the-proposed-atlantic-coast-pipeline-route-in-north-carolina): Data analysis tools for community environmental justice pipeline assessment
- [Jumpstarting North Carolina's Blue Economy: Opportunities in Ecosystem Technologies](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/144947-jumpstarting-north-carolina-s-blue-economy-opportunities-in-ecosystem-technologies): Emerging technologies for North Carolina's blue economy growth

## Optional & Specialized Topics

- [Integrated Governance: Achieving Governance Results and Contributing to Sector Outcomes](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/35782-integrated-governance-achieving-governance-results-and-contributing-to-sector-outcomes): Study on governance program integration with sector interventions
- [2024 National Institute of Justice Forensic Science Research and Development Symposium](https://rtipress.scholasticahq.com/article/121779-2024-national-institute-of-justice-forensic-science-research-and-development-symposium-american-academy-of-forensic-sciences-76th-annual-scientific-c): NIJ forensic science symposium conference proceedings & research findings
